The '''Alderaan Noble Estate''' was type of real estate property on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], available on the [[Stronghold directory terminal|Stronghold market]] during the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Alderaan Noble Estate is the Alderaan stronghold introduced in update 6.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''.
